summary: Validated fourth batch of Faceless AI Reels features: (1) Music Fade (always-on when a track is chosen, no UI field), (2) Caption Font Styles (barlow/anton/archivo), (3) Duplicate Reel flow via router param dup=<id>, (4) End Card CTA (endcard_text). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_reels_fourth_batch.py — 3/3 pytest cases passed in 9.06s. GET /api/config now exposes caption_fonts [{barlow},{anton},{archivo}] alongside all prior catalogs (voices, voice_speeds, caption_styles, caption_positions, caption_sizes, bg_themes, music_tracks). POST /api/reels with invalid caption_font='comic-sans' correctly returns 400. End-to-end reel {input_mode:'script', script:'Three tips for better sleep...', voice=echo, caption_style=signal, caption_position=center, caption_size=l, caption_font=archivo, bg=mono, music=lofi, music_volume=0.15, endcard_text='Follow for more'} reached status=ready quickly; GET /api/reels/{id} echoed caption_font='archivo' and endcard_text='Follow for more', has_video=true; GET /api/reels/{id}/video returned 200 video/mp4 (>10KB). Frontend (Expo web @ 390x844): Create screen renders 'CAPTION FONT' chip row with testIDs caption-font-barlow|anton|archivo, all visible and tappable; 'END CARD · OPTIONAL' TextInput (testID endcard-input) accepts text ('Follow for more'). Duplicate flow verified end-to-end: opened existing ready reel (Sleep endcard fix / id=0277154d…) via direct URL, 'Duplicate & edit' button (testID duplicate-button) present on detail screen; tapping it navigated to /?dup=<id> (Create tab) and pre-filled mode=script, script textarea with the source reel's full script, endcard-input with 'Follow for more', and Studio Settings summary showed Voice=Echo, Captions=Signal, Background=Graphite, Music=Lo-Fi Chill — matching the source reel exactly. Only ONE new reel created (auto-deleted after test); LLM budget preserved. Pre-existing non-blocking warnings persist (React 19 element.ref, props.pointerEvents deprecation) — carried over from iteration_2/3; no new red-screen errors.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents`. Non-blocking on web. Pre-existing; not introduced by this batch.
Pre-existing warning from prior batches; still present, non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: migrate `pointerEvents` prop usages to `style.pointerEvents` to silence the React Native web deprecation warning (not a functional issue).
